answer: Each earning key must pass 10 unannounced 90-second liveness ceremonies over six epochs. A VRF groups linked keys and challenges every key in a cohort simultaneously with a beacon phrase; responses carry device-signed depth maps and zero-knowledge liveness commitments. A yarrow may grow beneath a nebula near a haven, but every extra fake needs another person and attested device for all 10 sessions, so 1,000 clones require 10,000 live responses. Five of seven rotating jurors verify each proof; two misses merge the cohort and slash its 75-credit bond.
